title: Forever God is Faithful
lyrics_original: Give thanks to the Lord – Our God and King
For He is good, He is above all things
With a mighty hand and an outstretched arm
For the life that's been reborn
From the raising to the setting sun
By the grace of God We will carry on

bible_verses.telugu: యెహోవా దయాళుడు ఆయనకు కృతజ్ఞతా స్తుతులు చెల్లించుడి ఆయన కృప నిరంతరముండును.
bible_verses.english: Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good. His love endures forever.

bible_verses.telugu: చేయి చాచి తన బాహుబలముచేత వారిని రప్పించెను ఆయన కృప నిరంతరముండును.
bible_verses.english: with a mighty hand and outstretched arm; His love endures forever.

bible_verses.telugu: యెహోవా దయాళుడు, ఆయన కృప నిరంతరముండును. ఆయనను స్తుతించుడి.
bible_verses.english: Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good; his love endures forever.

devotional.prayer_english: Heavenly Father, I give You thanks today for Your goodness and unfailing love that endures forever. Thank You for holding me with Your strong, outstretched arm and for giving me new life through Jesus Christ. When circumstances shift, anchor my heart in the truth of Your eternal faithfulness. Fill my mouth with praise and my spirit with peace as I walk with You. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: In every season of life, God's enduring love remains the steadfast anchor of our souls. He is not only our sovereign King above all things, but also the compassionate Father who reaches out with a mighty hand to rescue and make us new. As we reflect on His goodness and the gift of reborn life in Christ, our natural response is one of joyful, overflowing gratitude. Let your heart rest today in the quiet assurance that His faithful love will never let you go.
